review_question: How accurately do computer-aided fundus-photo classifiers identify diabetic retinopathy relative to expert ophthalmologist classification?

targets.comparison: Computer-aided classification versus expert ophthalmologist reference classification
targets.population_or_subgroup: Held-out retinal fundus image test set

timepoint_policy.rule: Use the held-out/test-set evaluation explicitly reported by the source, not training performance.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: One image-level diagnostic 2x2 table per report

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract TP, FP, FN, and TN from a primary-report test-set table. Recompute sensitivity and specificity from counts. Do not accept a percentage alone or use a review forest value.
